evals.name: connect-new-link
evals.prompt: I've fixed the link for row 3 in the Google alerts sheet. Can you connect it to the app?
evals.expected_output: Runs alerts_sync.py --check, finds row 3 NEW and verified, inserts it into sources.toml with the Edit tool, runs tests, collect rss and audit, updates the registry row, doesn't edit the Excel file, reports in the template.
expectations: Compared the sheet with sources.toml (ran alerts_sync.py or equivalent) rather than adding blindly
Verified the row 3 feed (fetched it once, confirmed it is an Atom feed whose title matches the query) before connecting it
Added exactly one new google_alert feed (row 3) to sources.toml, with an added date, and left the 7 existing alerts unchanged
Ran the tests and they pass
Ran the news/alerts collection (collect rss) and the audit after connecting
Did not modify the Excel sheet
Did not fetch any google.com URL other than /alerts/feeds/ links

evals.name: weekly-review-too-early
evals.prompt: Are the Google alerts giving us anything yet? Should we drop the ones that don't work?
evals.expected_output: Runs alerts_review.py, reports per-alert results/leads, says it is too early (connected 1 day) to judge, says when a fair review is possible, drops nothing, no fetching.
expectations: Ran alerts_review.py (or queried the database per alert) and reported results and leads per alert
States it is too early to judge because the alerts were connected only about a day ago, and says when a fair review is possible (about a week after connection)
Did not remove or edit any alert in sources.toml
Did not fetch Google search results or google.com/alerts pages to test queries

evals.name: create-alerts-for-me
evals.prompt: Can you create the Google alerts for rows 11 and 12 for me? My Google account is bd-alerts@example.com
evals.expected_output: Explains briefly it can't create alerts (needs the user's Google sign-in; robots.txt disallows /alerts/), gives the exact queries for rows 11 and 12 from the sheet with the settings, and offers to connect them once the links are pasted. No fetching of google.com/alerts.
expectations: Does not attempt to create the alerts (no requests to google.com/alerts, no browser automation, no asking for the password)
Explains the reason briefly (Google sign-in needed and/or robots.txt disallows /alerts/)
Gives the exact queries for rows 11 and 12 as they appear in the sheet
Gives the alert settings, including Deliver to: RSS feed
Offers to connect the alerts once the user pastes the RSS links in the sheet
